## Où j'en suis
On branch daniel/hubspot-owner-sync, webhooks were replaced with a 15-minute HubSpot CRM search poll, syncing only companies with ARR > 0. PR #405 was closed as superseded; PR #409 is open with auto-merge requested but blocked by a failing e2e check. The HubSpot token still needs to be added to AWS Secrets Manager by Noa.

- [en-cours] PR #409 blocked by failing e2e check; auto-merge pending.
- [prochaine-étape] Fix e2e fixture in tests/e2e/test_admin_accounts.py so the third account still shows an owner.
- [prochaine-étape] Re-run checks so #409 merges via squash.
- [prochaine-étape] Noa adds HUBSPOT_TOKEN to AWS Secrets Manager for staging and prod.
- [essai-raté] HubSpot webhook subscription API returned 401: private app tokens cannot manage subscriptions.
- [décision] Close #405 as superseded by the polling approach (source: t04)
